title: The net that keeps the mosaic aligned
description: Fold the six exterior faces and compare the printed markings.

difficulty.label: Uncalibrated
difficulty.basis: Track an ordered corner and transport the orientation of individual motifs.

question: The net is shown from the printed side. Place that side down before folding upward, so the markings face outward. The left image shows a cube with different patterns on its six faces from a particular viewing angle. The options are nets of the cube, which are folded upward to form the cube. Which net, when folded, can form the cube shown in the left image? Please choose from options A, B, C, or D.

annotation.Question: The left image shows a cube with different patterns on its six faces from a particular viewing angle. The options are nets of the cube, which are folded upward to form the cube. Which net, when folded, can form the cube shown in the left image? Please choose from options A, B, C, or D.

Explanation.B: Option B is correct because the relative positions of the three faces match the cube shown in the left image.

answer.explanation: Reading the net from its upper left, the top, left and right faces come from tile with top row magenta, black, green (column 1, row 2 from the upper left), then tile with top row blank, magenta, blank (column 2, row 3 from the upper left), then tile with top row magenta, black, blank (column 2, row 2 from the upper left). All three markings retain the pictured orientation.

options.label: A
options.explanation: The three faces meet, but tile with top row magenta, black, green (column 1, row 2 from the upper left), tile with top row blank, magenta, blank (column 2, row 2 from the upper left), tile with top row blank, red, green (column 3, row 3 from the upper left) in top/left/right order reverses their order around the vertex.

options.label: B
options.explanation: Reading the net from its upper left, the top, left and right faces come from tile with top row magenta, black, green (column 1, row 2 from the upper left), then tile with top row blank, magenta, blank (column 2, row 3 from the upper left), then tile with top row magenta, black, blank (column 2, row 2 from the upper left). All three markings retain the pictured orientation.

options.label: C
options.explanation: tile with top row blank, red, green (column 4, row 2 from the upper left) and tile with top row magenta, black, blank (column 2, row 2 from the upper left) are opposite and cannot meet at the visible corner.

options.label: D
options.explanation: The face order matches. The top face from tile with top row green, magenta, black (column 1, row 1 from the upper left) would need an extra 270 degree counterclockwise turn to reproduce the view.
